## Refine one slide with an instruction (Human-in-the-Loop)
**Refine request** = POST `/webhook/cstam/refine-slide` `{deckId, slideIndex, instruction}` from the CSTAM interface (close the deck editor first: it saves the whole deck every 10 s). **Regenerate with instruction** calls the deck agents' regenerate webhook (the teammate's "RFP 60", credential RegenWebhook): the agent that owns the slide runs again with the instruction, code still checks the facts. **Save slide** writes the new slide through the studio's slide route (credential "Proposal Studio key"): validated and laid out with the deck's theme, like the editor's Regenerate. Answer: 200 `{status: "ok", slideIndex, title, warnings}` or `{status: "error", message}` (400 / 404 / 502 / 503 / 504).

nodes.name: Check request
nodes.notes: deckId, slideIndex (1 or more: 0 is the title slide), instruction of 3 to 200 characters; else 400. REGENERATE_URL and STUDIO_URL at its top.

nodes.name: Regenerate with instruction
nodes.notes: POST {deckId, slideIndex, instruction} to the deck agents' regenerate webhook (RFP 60, credential RegenWebhook): one slide spec, or 400 / 404. Timeout 90 s, every HTTP status read by Check slide.

nodes.name: Check slide
nodes.notes: Only a NEW slide goes on: the current slide kept by the agents (too slow, invalid) or a slide of placeholders (LLM down) is never saved.

nodes.name: Save slide
nodes.notes: POST the slide spec to the studio's /api/decks/<deckId>/slides/<slideIndex> (credential "Proposal Studio key"): validated, laid out with the deck's theme and saved, like the editor's Regenerate.

nodes.name: Reset price approval
nodes.notes: Like the editor after its own Regenerate: a refined slide with prices needs a new approval before export.
